prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Browse and pick the perfect pet personality to join your desktop space.", "Choose Pet"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Home", "While your pet is being generated, here is a quick overview of how to interact with it on your desktop.", "Got It, Take Me There", "Pet Care Tips"]
3: ["Your Desktop Pet is Active!", "Check out your pet's location and learn basic mouse and keyboard actions.", "Quick Start Actions"]
4: ["Bring Life to Your Screen", "Watch your pet react, play, and keep you company as you work.", "Continue Setup"]
5: ["Choose Your Quick Onboarding Path", "Select standard adoption for instant setup, or custom build for full photo customization."]
6: ["Sign in with your main account to ensure your custom pet save state and achievements are automatically synced.", "Using Google or Apple login preserves your pet across re-installs."]
7: ["Preparing pet assets...", "Did you know?"]
8: ["Upload bright, front-facing photos for optimal custom pet generation results.", "Best Results: Well-lit single photo"]
9: ["Claim Pet & Finish", "Onboarding Complete: Pet Ready!"]
